literal_meaning: ভূতের বোঝা বহন করা (carrying the ghost's burden)
figurative_meaning_en: Taking on family or household responsibilities
similar_in_english: Bearing the weight of household duties
example_sentences_in_bangla: বিয়ের পর সে ভূতের বোঝা বওয়া শুরু করল।
পিতার অসুস্থতায় ছেলে ভূতের বোঝা বওয়ার দায়িত্ব নিল।
example_sentences_in_english: After marriage, he started carrying the ghost's burden.
Due to his father's illness, the son took on the responsibility of carrying the ghost's burden.
history: This idiom draws from Bengali folklore where ghosts (bhoot) symbolize unseen or burdensome elements, metaphorically representing the invisible weight of family duties in traditional rural life.
note: The idiom evokes the idea of an intangible yet heavy load, akin to supernatural folklore common in Bengali culture.
